children: Biocon Ltd on Friday said it has received approval from the UK's Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) for its new drug product fill-finish unit for Semglee (insulin glargine) at its insulin manufacturing facility in Malaysia.
According to a regulatory filing by the company, the development follows regulatory approval secured from the European Medicines Agency (EMA) in July for this new drug product fill-finish line.
Biocon's fill-finish lines are used for aseptic formulation, sterile packaging, and final delivery preparation of biologics, insulins, recombinant proteins, peptides, and monoclonal antibodies.

title: Biocon Malaysia gets UK MHRA approval for new drug product fill-finish unit for insulins
